_doc: Dinosaur v2 animation spec: what tools/dino/gen.py asks PixelLab for.
Each clip is generated per facing (side = facing right, down = toward the viewer, up = away) from art/dino-v2/first/<key>_<facing>.png.
model: 'ai' = animate_image (steady; used for loops, last frame pinned to the first so the cycle closes), 'pmm' = animate_image_pixminimax (bigger, livelier motion; used for actions).
frames = frames generated after the input frame. loop clips drop the pinned last frame; action clips keep the input frame as frame 0 so they start from the resting pose.
clean: ground = keep the lowest opaque row on the ground line; anchor = remove sideways drift of the body; both only for planted clips.
{motion} is the clip's motion text; the facing and style clauses are appended by gen.py.
Prompts are short and motion-only: the model sees the drawing, and naming the body, effects to avoid, or words like breathing/struck/snorts/slams makes it paint steam, sparkles, flashes and dust.
clean.clamp_top: locomotion loops may not rise more than N px above the resting drawing's top (the model likes to grow crests and quills into pillars).
overrides: {"KEY/CLIP_VIEW": {model?, motion?}} replaces the clip's defaults for that one facing (gen.py uses them on every submit).
clean.clamp_sides: front/back idle and walk frames may not reach more than N px beyond the resting drawing's sides (ghost tails, bulging crests).
views: a clip drawn in only some facings (tail_swing_far is side-on only). procedural: the clip is built by the named tool, never generated (gen.py plans no jobs for it).

side.clause: It stays in place, facing right.

down.clause: It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

up.clause: It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

idle.motion: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little.

motion.biped: Walks in place: its legs step one after the other, its body bobs gently with each step and its tail sways.
motion.quadruped: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways.
motion.dimetrodon: Walks in place on its four splayed legs like a big lizard, its body swaying from side to side with each step and its tail swishing.

motion.biped: Runs in place with long fast strides, its body leaning forward and its tail held straight out behind.
motion.trike: Gallops in place with its head lowered and its horns pointing forward, legs moving fast.
motion.dodo: Runs in place on its short legs, flapping its little wings.
motion.lystro: Scurries in place on its four short stubby legs with quick little steps, its stout body bobbing and its head held low and forward.
motion.quadruped: Trots in place on four legs with quick steps, its body bobbing.
motion.dimetrodon: Scuttles in place on its four splayed legs with quick sprawling steps, its body swaying from side to side, its head held low and forward.
motion.anky: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways.

motion.default: Lowers its head to the ground, eats the grass with a few bites, then lifts its head back up.
motion.longneck: Lowers its long neck down to the ground, eats the grass, then raises its neck back up.
motion.dodo: Pecks at the ground twice to eat seeds, then straightens up.
motion.sucho: Lowers its long snout to the ground, snaps up food and gulps it down with a few bites, then lifts its head back up.
motion.spino: Lowers its long snout to the ground, snaps up food and gulps it down with a few bites, then lifts its head back up.

sniff.motion: Lowers its head to sniff the ground, then raises it and looks around.

hurt.motion: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance.

death.motion: Stumbles, its legs give way and it falls over onto its side, then lies still.

bite.motion: Pulls its head back with its jaws open, then snaps its head forward and bites, then returns to its stance.

chomp.motion: Rears its head back, lunges forward and bites down hard, shakes its head from side to side, then lets go and returns to its stance.

motion.default: Crouches and tenses, throws its head back and opens its jaws wide in a roar, then lowers its head, ready to charge.
motion.dimetrodon: Raises its head and opens its jaws wide, holding the pose for a moment, then lowers its head back to its stance.

motion.default: Darts forward, snaps its jaws and swipes with its clawed hands, then springs back into its stance.
motion.spino: Rears up a little and rakes down with its big clawed arms, then settles back into its stance.

pounce.motion: Crouches low, jumps forward into the air with its foot claws raised, lands and recovers.

motion.stego: Swings its spiked tail out to the side in a wide fast sweep, then brings it back behind it. Its body and feet stay still.
motion.longneck: Swings its long tail out to the side in a wide sweep, then brings it back behind it. Its body and feet stay still.
motion.anky: Swings its heavy clubbed tail out to the side in a wide fast sweep, then brings it back behind it. Its body and feet stay still.

stomp.motion: Rears up on its hind legs, lifting its front legs high, then brings its front feet down hard onto the ground and settles.

windup.motion: Lowers its head so its horns point forward and scrapes the ground with one front foot, getting ready to charge.

gore.motion: Keeps all four feet on the ground: dips its head, then swings its horned head sideways in a powerful hooking swipe, then returns to its stance.

peck.motion: Lunges its head forward and pecks hard twice with its beak, then straightens up.

motion.default: Crouches low, raises its clawed arms and opens its jaws wide in a screech, holds the pose for a moment, then settles back into its stance.
motion.stego: Lowers its head and lifts its spiked tail high, swinging it from side to side as a warning, then lowers it again.
motion.anky: Plants its feet and swings its clubbed tail from side to side as a warning, then lets it hang again.
motion.proto: Lowers its head and opens its beak wide in a hiss, stamping one front foot, then settles back.
motion.compy: Crouches, opens its jaws wide in a shrill screech and flicks its tail, then settles.

rex/walk_down.motion: Walks in place toward the viewer, hunched with its head held low: its legs step one after the other and its shoulders sway from side to side.

rex/run_down.motion: Runs in place toward the viewer, hunched with its head held low: its legs pump fast and its shoulders sway.

stego/tail_swing_down.motion: Keeps its body and head facing the viewer and swings its tail out from behind its body to one side in a wide fast sweep, then back behind it. Only the tail moves.

stego/tail_swing_up.motion: Keeps its back to the viewer and swings its tail out to one side in a wide fast sweep, then back to the middle. Only the tail moves.

raptor/slash_up.motion: Lunges forward away from the viewer, snapping its jaws and swiping with its clawed hands, then springs back.

raptor/sniff_up.motion: Lowers its head to sniff the ground in front of it, then raises it again and looks left and right.

trike/windup_up.motion: Keeps its back to the viewer: lowers its head and paws the ground twice with one front foot.

trike/eat_up.motion: Keeps its back to the viewer: lowers its head to the ground and eats the grass, then lifts its head again.
